adjudication.rationale: The finding claims that passing the full Referer URL as postMessage targetOrigin will reject normal embedding pages with a path. Looking at the diff, in app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb line 11, the code uses `request.referer` as the targetOrigin. The postMessage API's targetOrigin parameter checks the origin (scheme + host + port), not the full URL path. When a full URL is passed, the browser extracts just the origin portion for comparison. So passing 'http://example.com/some/path' as targetOrigin will still match messages to 'http://example.com'. The finding misunderstands how postMessage targetOrigin works - it doesn't require an exact URL match, just origin match.
